from datetime import UTC, datetime, timedelta

from geoloc_lib.repository.regular_campaign_execution_repository import (
    RegularCampaignExecutionRepository,
)
from geoloc_lib.schemas.regular_campaign_schema import (
    RegularCampaignExecutionReason,
    RegularCampaignExecutionStatus,
    RegularCampaignExecutionUpdate,
)
from geoloc_connector.core.logger import app_logger

from geoloc_connector.settings import settings
from tasks.faststream_app import REGULAR_CAMPAIGN_QUEUE, broker


async def retry_failed_dispatches(*, now: datetime | None = None) -> str:
    reference = now or datetime.now(UTC)
    repository = RegularCampaignExecutionRepository()

    app_logger.info(
        "regular_campaign_dispatch_retry_start",
        reference=reference,
        limit=settings.REGULAR_CAMPAIGN_DISPATCH_RETRY_BATCH_SIZE,
    )
    executions = await repository.find_dispatch_retry_candidates(
        now=reference,
        limit=settings.REGULAR_CAMPAIGN_DISPATCH_RETRY_BATCH_SIZE,
    )
    app_logger.info(
        "regular_campaign_dispatch_retry_candidates_found",
        reference=reference,
        candidate_count=len(executions),
    )

    retried = 0
    moved_to_dlq = 0
    for execution in executions:
        age = reference - execution.created_at
        retry_exhausted = execution.dispatch_attempts > settings.REGULAR_CAMPAIGN_DISPATCH_MAX_RETRIES

        age_exhausted = age >= timedelta(seconds=settings.REGULAR_CAMPAIGN_DISPATCH_MAX_AGE_SECONDS)
        app_logger.info(
            "regular_campaign_dispatch_retry_candidate_evaluated",
            campaign_id=execution.campaign_id,
            execution_id=execution.execution_id,
            tenant_id=execution.tenant_id,
            dispatch_attempts=execution.dispatch_attempts,
            age_seconds=age.total_seconds(),
            retry_exhausted=retry_exhausted,
            age_exhausted=age_exhausted,
        )
        if retry_exhausted or age_exhausted:
            await repository.update_execution(
                execution.execution_id,
                execution.tenant_id,
                RegularCampaignExecutionUpdate(
                    status=RegularCampaignExecutionStatus.DLQ,
                    status_reason=RegularCampaignExecutionReason.DISPATCH_RETRY_EXHAUSTED,
                    finished_at=reference,
                ),
            )
            moved_to_dlq += 1
            app_logger.error(
                "regular_campaign_dispatch_dlq",
                campaign_id=execution.campaign_id,
                execution_id=execution.execution_id,
                tenant_id=execution.tenant_id,
                dispatch_attempts=execution.dispatch_attempts,
            )
            continue

        await broker.publish(
            {
                "campaign_id": execution.campaign_id,
                "execution_id": execution.execution_id,
                "tenant_id": execution.tenant_id,
            },
            queue=REGULAR_CAMPAIGN_QUEUE,
        )
        await repository.update_execution(
            execution.execution_id,
            execution.tenant_id,
            RegularCampaignExecutionUpdate(
                status=RegularCampaignExecutionStatus.PENDING_DISPATCH,
                status_reason=None,
                dispatch_attempts=execution.dispatch_attempts + 1,
                next_retry_at=reference,
            ),
        )
        retried += 1
        app_logger.info(
            "regular_campaign_dispatch_retried",
            campaign_id=execution.campaign_id,
            execution_id=execution.execution_id,
            tenant_id=execution.tenant_id,
            dispatch_attempts=execution.dispatch_attempts + 1,
        )

    app_logger.info(
        "regular_campaign_dispatch_retry_finished",
        reference=reference,
        retried=retried,
        dlq=moved_to_dlq,
    )
    return f"retried={retried} dlq={moved_to_dlq}"

from apscheduler.schedulers.asyncio import AsyncIOScheduler

from apscheduler.triggers.cron import CronTrigger

from geoloc_connector.core.logger import app_logger

from tasks.faststream_app import (
    REGULAR_CAMPAIGN_RETRY_QUEUE,
    REPORTS_DAILY_QUEUE,
    REPORTS_HOURLY_QUEUE,
    REPORTS_MESSAGE_QUEUE,
    broker,
)

scheduler = AsyncIOScheduler()


async def _trigger_hourly_report() -> None:
    await broker.publish({"trigger": "generate_hourly_report"}, queue=REPORTS_HOURLY_QUEUE)


async def _trigger_daily_report() -> None:
    await broker.publish({"trigger": "generate_daily_report"}, queue=REPORTS_DAILY_QUEUE)


async def _trigger_message_report() -> None:
    await broker.publish({"trigger": "generate_message_report"}, queue=REPORTS_MESSAGE_QUEUE)


async def _trigger_retry_failed_dispatches() -> None:
    await broker.publish({"trigger": "retry_failed_regular_campaign_dispatches"}, queue=REGULAR_CAMPAIGN_RETRY_QUEUE)


def register_scheduled_jobs() -> None:
    scheduler.add_job(
        _trigger_hourly_report, CronTrigger(minute="*/1"), id="generate_hourly_report", replace_existing=True
    )
    scheduler.add_job(
        _trigger_daily_report, CronTrigger(minute="*/1"), id="generate_daily_report", replace_existing=True
    )
    scheduler.add_job(
        _trigger_message_report, CronTrigger(minute="*/1"), id="generate_message_report", replace_existing=True
    )
    scheduler.add_job(
        _trigger_retry_failed_dispatches,
        CronTrigger(minute="*/1"),
        id="retry_failed_regular_campaign_dispatches",
        replace_existing=True,
    )
    app_logger.info("scheduler_jobs_registered")

from faststream import FastStream

from geoloc_connector.core.database import init_db

from geoloc_connector.core.logger import app_logger


from tasks.core.worker_bootstrap import register_worker_bootstrap

from tasks.faststream_app import app
from tasks.scheduler import register_scheduled_jobs, scheduler

register_worker_bootstrap(app)


@app.after_startup
async def start_scheduler() -> None:
    try:
        register_scheduled_jobs()
        scheduler.start()
        app_logger.info("scheduler_started_success")
        for job in scheduler.get_jobs():
            app_logger.info(
                "scheduler_job_registered",
                id=job.id,
                next_run=str(job.next_run_time),
            )
    except Exception:
        app_logger.error("error_on_startup", exc_info=True)


@app.on_shutdown
async def stop_scheduler() -> None:
    try:
        scheduler.shutdown(wait=False)
        app_logger.info("scheduler_shutdown_success")
    except Exception:
        app_logger.error("error_on_shutdown", exc_info=True)

import httpx
from geoloc_lib.repository.campaign_repository import CampaignRepository

from geoloc_lib.schemas.regular_campaign_schema import (
    RegularCampaignBatchStatus,
    RegularCampaignExecutionReason,
    RegularCampaignExecutionStatus,
)
from geoloc_connector.core.logger import app_logger

from geoloc_connector.services.regular_campaign_clients import (
    MessagingClient,
    SegmentationClient,
    SegmentationStreamError,
)
from geoloc_connector.services.regular_campaign_service import RegularCampaignService
from geoloc_connector.settings import settings
from tasks.regular_campaign.constants import PAUSE_REASONS


class RegularCampaignExecutionWorkflow:
    def determine_final_status(
        self,
        *,
        stopped_reason: RegularCampaignExecutionReason | None,
        had_failures: bool,
    ) -> RegularCampaignExecutionStatus:
        if stopped_reason == RegularCampaignExecutionReason.CAMPAIGN_TERMINATED:
            return RegularCampaignExecutionStatus.CANCELED
        if stopped_reason in PAUSE_REASONS:
            return RegularCampaignExecutionStatus.PAUSED
        if had_failures:
            return RegularCampaignExecutionStatus.PARTIAL_FAILED
        return RegularCampaignExecutionStatus.COMPLETED

    def _stop_reason_for_campaign_status(self, campaign_status: str) -> RegularCampaignExecutionReason:
        if campaign_status == "terminated":
            return RegularCampaignExecutionReason.CAMPAIGN_TERMINATED
        return RegularCampaignExecutionReason.CAMPAIGN_PAUSED

    async def execute(
        self,
        campaign_id: str,
        execution_id: str,
        tenant_id: str,
    ) -> str:
        service = RegularCampaignService()
        campaign_repository = CampaignRepository()

        app_logger.info(
            "regular_campaign_execution_start",
            campaign_id=campaign_id,
            execution_id=execution_id,
            tenant_id=tenant_id,
        )

        execution = await service.execution_repository.get_by_execution_id(execution_id, tenant_id)

        if execution is None or execution.snapshot is None:
            app_logger.error(
                "regular_campaign_execution_missing",
                campaign_id=campaign_id,
                execution_id=execution_id,
                tenant_id=tenant_id,
            )
            return f"execution {execution_id} not found or missing snapshot"

        app_logger.info(
            "regular_campaign_execution_loaded",
            campaign_id=campaign_id,
            execution_id=execution_id,
            tenant_id=tenant_id,
            requested_quota=execution.requested_quota,
            requested_count=execution.requested_count,
            accepted_count=execution.accepted_count,
            failed_count=execution.failed_count,
        )

        campaign = await campaign_repository.get_campaign_by_id(campaign_id, tenant_id)
        if campaign is None:
            await service.update_execution(
                execution_id=execution_id,
                tenant_id=tenant_id,
                status=RegularCampaignExecutionStatus.FAILED,
                status_reason=RegularCampaignExecutionReason.SEGMENTATION_ERROR,
            )
            app_logger.error(
                "regular_campaign_campaign_missing", campaign_id=campaign_id, execution_id=execution_id
            )
            return f"campaign {campaign_id} not found"

        app_logger.info(
            "regular_campaign_campaign_loaded",
            campaign_id=campaign_id,
            execution_id=execution_id,
            tenant_id=tenant_id,
            campaign_status=campaign.status,
        )

        if not service.is_campaign_active_for_sending(campaign.status):
            stopped_reason = self._stop_reason_for_campaign_status(campaign.status)

            status = (
                RegularCampaignExecutionStatus.CANCELED
                if campaign.status == "terminated"
                else RegularCampaignExecutionStatus.PAUSED
            )
            app_logger.info(
                "regular_campaign_execution_stopped_before_send",
                campaign_id=campaign_id,
                execution_id=execution_id,
                tenant_id=tenant_id,
                campaign_status=campaign.status,
                status=status,
                status_reason=stopped_reason,
            )
            await service.update_execution(
                execution_id=execution_id,
                tenant_id=tenant_id,
                status=status,
            )
            return f"campaign {campaign_id} is not active for sending"

        snapshot = execution.snapshot

        if not service.is_within_allowed_window(snapshot.allowed_times):
            app_logger.info(
                "regular_campaign_execution_outside_allowed_window",
                campaign_id=campaign_id,
                execution_id=execution_id,
                tenant_id=tenant_id,
            )

            await service.update_execution(
                execution_id=execution_id,
                tenant_id=tenant_id,
                status=RegularCampaignExecutionStatus.PAUSED,
                status_reason=RegularCampaignExecutionReason.OUTSIDE_ALLOWED_WINDOW,
            )
            return f"execution {execution_id} is outside its allowed window"

        await service.update_execution(
            execution_id=execution_id,
            tenant_id=tenant_id,
            status=RegularCampaignExecutionStatus.RUNNING,
        )

        app_logger.info(
            "regular_campaign_execution_running",
            campaign_id=campaign_id,
            execution_id=execution_id,
            tenant_id=tenant_id,
        )

        segmentation_client = SegmentationClient(
            base_url=settings.SEGMENTATION_API_URL,
            api_key=settings.SEGMENTATION_API_KEY,
            api_key_id=settings.SEGMENTATION_API_KEY_ID,
            timeout_seconds=settings.REGULAR_CAMPAIGN_STREAM_TIMEOUT_SECONDS,
        )
        messaging_client = MessagingClient(
            base_url=settings.MESSAGE_SEND_API_URL,
            api_key=settings.MESSAGE_SEND_API_KEY,
            api_key_id=settings.MESSAGE_SEND_API_KEY_ID,
            timeout_seconds=settings.REGULAR_CAMPAIGN_SEND_TIMEOUT_SECONDS,
        )
        app_logger.info(
            "regular_campaign_clients_initialized",
            campaign_id=campaign_id,
            execution_id=execution_id,
            tenant_id=tenant_id,
            segmentation_base_url=settings.SEGMENTATION_API_URL,
            messaging_base_url=settings.MESSAGE_SEND_API_URL,
        )

        remaining_quota = execution.requested_quota - execution.accepted_count
        requested_count = execution.requested_count
        accepted_count = execution.accepted_count
        failed_count = execution.failed_count
        batch_index = 0
        had_failures = False
        stopped_reason: RegularCampaignExecutionReason | None = None

        app_logger.info(
            "regular_campaign_quota_initialized",
            campaign_id=campaign_id,
            execution_id=execution_id,
            tenant_id=tenant_id,
            remaining_quota=remaining_quota,
            requested_count=requested_count,
            accepted_count=accepted_count,
            failed_count=failed_count,
        )

        try:
            payload = service.build_segmentation_request(snapshot, remaining_quota=remaining_quota)

            async for chunk in segmentation_client.iter_msisdn_chunks(payload):
                app_logger.info(
                    "regular_campaign_segmentation_chunk_processing",
                    campaign_id=campaign_id,
                    execution_id=execution_id,
                    tenant_id=tenant_id,
                    batch_index=batch_index,
                    chunk_msisdn_count=len(chunk),
                    remaining_quota=remaining_quota,
                )
                if remaining_quota <= 0:
                    stopped_reason = RegularCampaignExecutionReason.QUOTA_EXHAUSTED
                    app_logger.info(
                        "regular_campaign_execution_quota_exhausted",
                        campaign_id=campaign_id,
                        execution_id=execution_id,
                        tenant_id=tenant_id,
                        batch_index=batch_index,
                    )
                    break

                campaign = await campaign_repository.get_campaign_by_id(campaign_id, tenant_id)

                app_logger.info(
                    "regular_campaign_campaign_rechecked",
                    campaign_id=campaign_id,
                    execution_id=execution_id,
                    tenant_id=tenant_id,
                    batch_index=batch_index,
                    campaign_status=campaign.status if campaign else None,
                )

                if campaign is None or not service.is_campaign_active_for_sending(campaign.status):
                    stopped_reason = self._stop_reason_for_campaign_status(
                        campaign.status if campaign else "terminated"
                    )
                    app_logger.info(
                        "regular_campaign_execution_stopped_during_send",
                        campaign_id=campaign_id,
                        execution_id=execution_id,
                        tenant_id=tenant_id,
                        batch_index=batch_index,
                        campaign_status=campaign.status if campaign else None,
                        status_reason=stopped_reason,
                    )
                    break

                if not service.is_within_allowed_window(snapshot.allowed_times):
                    stopped_reason = RegularCampaignExecutionReason.OUTSIDE_ALLOWED_WINDOW
                    app_logger.info(
                        "regular_campaign_execution_window_closed_during_send",
                        campaign_id=campaign_id,
                        execution_id=execution_id,
                        tenant_id=tenant_id,
                        batch_index=batch_index,
                    )
                    break

                msisdns = service.dedupe_batch(chunk)

                msisdns = service.shrink_batch_to_quota(msisdns, remaining_quota=remaining_quota)

                if not msisdns:
                    app_logger.info(
                        "regular_campaign_batch_skipped_empty",
                        campaign_id=campaign_id,
                        execution_id=execution_id,
                        tenant_id=tenant_id,
                        batch_index=batch_index,
                        chunk_msisdn_count=len(chunk),
                    )
                    continue

                app_logger.info(
                    "regular_campaign_batch_prepared",
                    campaign_id=campaign_id,
                    execution_id=execution_id,
                    tenant_id=tenant_id,
                    batch_index=batch_index,
                    chunk_msisdn_count=len(chunk),
                    msisdn_count=len(msisdns),
                    remaining_quota=remaining_quota,
                )

                requested_count += len(msisdns)
                await service.record_batch(
                    execution_id=execution_id,
                    campaign_id=campaign_id,
                    batch_index=batch_index,
                    msisdns=msisdns,
                    tenant_id=tenant_id,
                )

                idempotency_key = service.compute_idempotency_key(
                    campaign_id=campaign_id, execution_id=execution_id, batch_index=batch_index
                )
                app_logger.info(
                    "regular_campaign_batch_recorded",
                    campaign_id=campaign_id,
                    execution_id=execution_id,
                    tenant_id=tenant_id,
                    batch_index=batch_index,
                    idempotency_key=idempotency_key,
                    msisdn_count=len(msisdns),
                )
                try:
                    response = await messaging_client.send_batch(
                        campaign_id=campaign_id,
                        msisdns=msisdns,
                        idempotency_key=idempotency_key,
                    )
                except httpx.HTTPStatusError as exc:
                    failed_count += len(msisdns)
                    had_failures = True
                    await service.mark_batch_result(
                        execution_id=execution_id,
                        batch_index=batch_index,
                        tenant_id=tenant_id,
                        status=RegularCampaignBatchStatus.FAILED,
                        attempt_count=1,
                        failed_count=len(msisdns),
                        http_status=exc.response.status_code,
                        error_message=str(exc),
                    )
                    app_logger.error(
                        "regular_campaign_batch_send_error",
                        exc_info=True,
                        campaign_id=campaign_id,
                        execution_id=execution_id,
                        batch_index=batch_index,
                    )
                else:
                    accepted_count += len(msisdns)

                    remaining_quota -= len(msisdns)

                    await service.mark_batch_result(
                        execution_id=execution_id,
                        batch_index=batch_index,
                        tenant_id=tenant_id,
                        status=RegularCampaignBatchStatus.ACCEPTED,
                        attempt_count=1,
                        accepted_count=len(msisdns),
                        http_status=response.status_code,
                    )
                    app_logger.info(
                        "regular_campaign_batch_sent",
                        campaign_id=campaign_id,
                        execution_id=execution_id,
                        batch_index=batch_index,
                        batch_size=len(msisdns),
                    )

                batch_index += 1
        except SegmentationStreamError as exc:
            had_failures = True
            stopped_reason = RegularCampaignExecutionReason.SEGMENTATION_ERROR
            app_logger.error(
                "regular_campaign_segmentation_contract_error",
                exc_info=True,
                campaign_id=campaign_id,
                execution_id=execution_id,
                error=str(exc),
            )
        finally:
            await segmentation_client.aclose()
            await messaging_client.aclose()

        final_status = (
            RegularCampaignExecutionStatus.FAILED
            if stopped_reason == RegularCampaignExecutionReason.SEGMENTATION_ERROR
            else self.determine_final_status(stopped_reason=stopped_reason, had_failures=had_failures)
        )

        await service.update_execution(
            execution_id=execution_id,
            tenant_id=tenant_id,
            status=final_status,
            status_reason=stopped_reason,
            requested_count=requested_count,
            accepted_count=accepted_count,
            failed_count=failed_count,
        )

        app_logger.info(
            "regular_campaign_execution_finished",
            campaign_id=campaign_id,
            execution_id=execution_id,
            tenant_id=tenant_id,
            status=final_status,
            requested_count=requested_count,
            accepted_count=accepted_count,
            failed_count=failed_count,
        )
        return f"execution {execution_id} finished as {final_status}"
